Dana Park: Kickoff prep for Rivera Medical onboarding. Quick internal roll call + owners so we can invite their team after rehearsal. Dry run tomorrow 09:30 PT?
Leo Martin: 09:30 works. I'll cover infra (auth, webhooks, retry/backoff) and perf expectations.
Hana Cho: I'll own enablement + sample prompts and the post-demo survey. Proposed 30-day wins: 1) staging app makes authenticated calls, 2) 5 validated prompts, 3) healthboard live with alerts.
Marcus Bell: I'll take success criteria tracking and renewal watch. Heads up: procurement target is 2026-07-01; flag as medium risk if no production signal by day 40.
Dana Park: Customer stakeholders: Priya Rao (PM), Omar Khalid (Data Eng), Lila Moore (Security). Internal: Dana (CS Lead), Leo (Platform SE), Hana (Enablement), Marcus (CS Ops).
Leo Martin: Suggested timeline: Day 0: creds & test org; Day 1-4: integration + schema mapping; Day 5-12: validation + perf tuning; Day 13-30: pilot + enablement. If they request VPC/private deploy add security window (+5 biz days).
Hana Cho: Success criteria (compact): - End-to-end demo in staging - 5 prompts with thumbs-up from PM - Median demo latency < 600ms - Healthboard alerts firing for errors
Marcus Bell: Renewal risk rules: HIGH if no pilot traffic by day 40 OR if security prevents required data egress. I'll add a "renewal_flag" column to the board with mitigation playbooks.
Dana Park: Capacity note: ask Rivera for expected QPS and batch sizes in pre-read. If embeddings ingest >500 vects/min recommend Dedicated trial or aggressive batching.
Leo Martin: Quick dev snippet for the enablement deck (pasteable):
```
# minimal sync example
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json={'model':'rwd-lite','prompt':'Extract diagnoses from note'})
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```
Hana Cho: I'll make a 25-min enablement deck + 10-min dev quickstart. Also drafting a 3-question post-demo survey: integration ease, prompt quality, blockers.

Dana Park: Action items: Leo - perf checklist + infra notes; Hana - deck + prompts + survey; Marcus - healthboard + renewal column; me - customer invite + agenda. Please add 5 example prompts to the shared doc before the rehearsal. Link: https://redwood.internal/cs/rivera-prompts (placeholder)
Leo Martin: I'll draft the perf checklist and add basic concurrency guidance (timeouts, retry) by EOD.
